title: Clients, plans and billing

scenes.say: Every client has an account in the Back Office: a plan, a balance in credits and a billing currency. In this video, you'll manage an account, add credits, issue an invoice and check client health.
Under Clients, click Client accounts. Self-service trials create themselves. For a client signed by sales, click New client.

Fill in the name, plan, billing currency and requests per minute. Kenyan entities pay in shillings. Check the starting credits: they're added straight away, with no invoice. If the client still has to pay, set them to zero and issue an invoice instead.
To change an account, find the client. Search by name, then click it. Here's Demo Bank Ltd, our demo client.

Under Account settings, a new plan changes the price of every future check at once. It adds no credits. A suspended or expired client can't start checks. Always give a reason for the audit log, then click Save changes.

To add or remove credits, choose the type: an allocation, a refund, or an adjustment. Enter the amount and a reason, then click Apply. The line appears in the credit ledger, and the client sees it too.
One rule about Demo Bank. It's invented, for the manual and training videos. Never edit it, add credits or invoice it. Engineering builds and resets it.

show.card: Demo Bank Ltd is for training only
show.subtitle: Don't edit it, add credits or invoice it

scenes.say: Now open Revenue and billing. Check Running out within seven days every morning, and tell each client's account manager.

To bill a client, use Issue an invoice. Choose the client, a plan prepayment or another charge, and the days to pay. When money arrives by bank or M-Pesa, find the invoice under Unpaid invoices and click Mark paid, with the transaction code. Paystack payments mark themselves paid.
The price list shows what each check costs on each plan. The US dollar to shilling rate also prices every shilling plan bought online, so update it monthly with the rate finance sets.
Finally, open Client health. Follow up every client whose usage is dropping. In Onboarding, find clients stuck before their first live check or first charge, and pass them to their account manager.
That's clients, plans and billing. To learn more, open chapter D3 in the Runbook.

notes: The new-client form is opened but never submitted; Create client is only highlighted. Clicking Demo Bank Ltd afterwards closes the form (setCreating(false)).

Typing 'Demo Bank' in the search box (label 'Search clients', sr-only) filters All clients down to Demo Bank Ltd, keeping other clients off screen. It assumes no other client name contains 'Demo Bank'.
The Client accounts list is visible for a moment before the search; the zoom is on the page heading only.

Revenue & billing shows other clients in Revenue by client, Low balance forecast and Unpaid invoices. Those panels are highlighted at most, never zoomed. card:Unpaid invoices assumes the invoice filter is on 'All clients (unpaid)' (the heading becomes 'Invoices' once a client is chosen).

field:Plan and field:Status rely on Playwright's substring label match; on Demo Bank's panel the first matches should be the Account settings selects. Save changes, Apply, Issue invoice, Save rate and Create client are highlighted only, never clicked.
Client health's Usage trend and Onboarding tables list other clients; only highlights are used there.
